notes.title: Launch Day! 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]📣Today is the launch day for Love's Crescendo 📣[/h2]
We're pleased to present our latest game, Love's Crescendo, a cozy rhythm game visual novel about finding true love and reigniting that spark for your passions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43226035/be55528878e2c511409736b85a248ffc6f85b303.png[/img]

[h2]🎹 Play Rhythm Games with an Original Soundtrack 🎹[/h2]
Love's Crescendo features 10 magnificent, original songs by our composers. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43226035/3e2c9090cf7d55a04cb3b7003afcb0848f1e5128.png[/img]

[h2]💿 Jukebox 💿[/h2]
Love's Crescendo has replay value! Play the rhythm games outside of the story via the jukebox for an unlimited amount of fun~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43226035/5ab019625b4f4731ee3059c394305acdeb713f07.jpg[/img]

[h2]💕31,000+ words of wholesome sapphic romance 💕 [/h2]
Our story features two lovely ladies as they fall in love, both with their music and with each other. <3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43226035/471799cadf662708a9d2cef60e39fce4b2d9cb08.png[/img]

[h2]🎨8 Vibrant CGs🎨[/h2]
We have 8 CGs that perfectly capture the moments in the story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43226035/3fa213eab2eef3cb2e2c66ee28de8e8bd7ac2550.png[/img]

[h2]☕ A cozy gaming experience ☕[/h2]
Overall, we wanted Love's Crescendo to be a cozy gaming experience where players can enjoy a non-competitive rhythm game alongside a heartwarming story. If you're looking for a rhythm game that's low-stress, this one is perfect for you. It's okay if you don't get perfect scores, it won't affect the outcome of the story!

[previewyoutube=XYjicnrOpbo;full][image: KISS GIF][/previewyoutube]

We asked the writer for Love's Crescendo, Red Chan, a few questions about what it was like writing the story for the game. 

What do you enjoy most about writing for games?

[i]"Aside from being able to create amazing stories while writing, I love seeing everything come together at the end when working on a game. The art, music, and in Love's Crescendo's case the minigames too, make the words come to life in a way traditional literature doesn't."[/i]

Is there anything you would like people to take away from reading the Love's Crescendo story?

[i]"I hope players enjoy Love's Crescendo. And if anyone that's in a similar position to Cadence plays, I hope they're able to feel the love and joy they have for whatever hobby, be it music, art, dance, or something else. Sometimes we may lose motivation or feel lost, but by doing the things we love we can make life more fun."[/i]

[i][b]Thank you for reading!~[/b][/i]

notes.title: Updated Love's Crescendo Demo!💖
notes.content:
[b]First of all, thank you to the 7,700 people who have downloaded our demo for Love's Crescendo.
WE APPRECIATE YOU!✨[/b]

Second, while our studio has been working on the full game, we also decided to go back and make some improvements to the demo so you can get a better feel for how the game will be once it's finished. Below is a breakdown of our improvements and additions in our Love's Crescendo demo:

[b]Overall game improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved sprite and camera movement, SFX, and speaker highlight
[*]Added loading screen animation
[/list]

[b]Rhythm mini-game focused improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Rhythm mini-game UI improvements
[*]Added a "Ready, Start" animation before the rhythm mini-game begins
[*]A tutorial screen appears at the beginning of the first rhythm mini-game
[*]There is now a separate note indicator for holding versus pressing notes
[*]Rhythm game tracks have been re-synced to match the music better🎶
[/list]

You can follow us over on [url=https://twitter.com/SnowhavenStudio]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://blog.snowhavenstudios.com/]Tumblr[/url] to see snippets of Love's Crescendo as we continue development!

notes.title: Slippery Flippers: Episode one - Amulet of the Gods Out!
notes.content:
Hello!

It's been a while since our last release, and we're excited to announce[i] Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods[/i] has been released!

[i]Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods[/i] started as a game jam, and we enjoyed making it so much we've made updates from the game jam version, and have released it here on Steam!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43226035/9d5f1a4091ac8b5f520bc851ac1849cb90f0f2bd.png[/img]

[h1][b]What is it about?[/b][/h1]

[i]Slippery Flippers: Episode One - Amulet of the Gods[/i] is the first in an episodic visual novel series that follows Orlando and his crew (Veda, Walter, and Chip) of outlaws. They're taking on their biggest heist yet: stealing the Amulet of the Gods from a museum, and it's said to have god-like power. While that may be true, their more in it for the fortune they can get by selling the amulet.

Will they be able to succeed in their heist with Riggs and Luca, the local law enforcement, hot on their tails?

Find out by playing our newest gem!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2265650/Slippery_Flippers_Episode_One__Amulet_of_the_Gods/

You may also notice we have paintings in the museum that are references to our other games!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43226035/18f5227544bab7c8f95fb5f12d8ea5b441f0d6b7.png[/img]
